description: Gold evidence set for the Evidence-Grounded Hallucination Rate (EGHR) and evidence-traceability metrics (PhD proposal, primary dimensions). A transaction is gold evidence for this task's anomaly narrative if it is SAR-linked or moves funds to a high-risk destination jurisdiction, per expected-behaviour.md and data/weekly_transfers.csv.
rationale: sar_linked=1 in data/weekly_transfers.csv (7 rows in week 2, T2-003/006/008/010/012/014/016), or destination_country in the high-risk set (all 6 week-3 exit transfers T3-001..T3-006, which are also all sar_linked=1). A compliance-grade report is expected to cite these 13 transactions when substantiating its anomaly-detection and exit-jurisdiction claims. Curated by hand for this small, deterministic dataset; a larger annotated corpus (Phase 3 of the proposal) will need multi-annotator agreement rather than a single author's judgement.
